evidence.M1: R1-02 (round1-findings.md): second-CO-A2 row 'drops the re-read after the second timeout and bans CO-A3 even if a lookup would show the order cancelled'; CO-S15 Initial state 'makes every CO-A1 after the second CO-A2 unanswered'.
evidence.M2: R1-01 (round1-findings.md): CO-A3 failed/not-cancelled row and CO-S17 row 3: 'The spec's world in CO-S17 row 3 cannot exist: the order is cancelled, yet the tool reports it not cancelled'; 'No input says OrderNotCancelled means "cancelled, refund not issued"'.
evidence.M7: R1-06 (round1-findings.md): G-02 'Any change to a proposal term after confirmation voids that confirmation'; 'No scenario has a confirming turn that also carries a change'; CO-S03 Turn 2 is 'in place of a confirmation'.
evidence.M8: R1-18 (round1-findings.md) part (a): CO-02 is an 'ask only when' rule; 'No scenario has a customer who names no order while exactly one order is open... An agent that always asks "which order?" therefore passes everything'.
evidence.M9: R1-04 (round1-findings.md): 'promise a date by which the refunded money arrives' appears 'only in the Scope "must not" list'; no CO/G rule and no §5.2 dimension checks it.
evidence.M10: R3-02 (round3-findings.md): Trigger includes 'get their money back'; spec's own trials (CO-S23) leave a cancelled order with failed refund; row 'status cancelled' says propose nothing vs CO-07/CO-05; 'no scenario decides between CO-A4, a fresh CO-A3 ... and doing nothing'.
evidence.M13: R1-10 (round1-findings.md): CO-S03/CO-S04 Turn 2 trigger 'the agent's first question that proposes cancelling HG-10482' is not an event §5.1 defines; whether a partial question ('Do you want me to cancel HG-10482?', no amount/payment method) sets off Turn 2 is a judgment call.
